column1: # Partition table — 4MB flash with dual OTA + shrunk SPIFFS (WIFI variant)
# Sibling to ota_4mb.csv. Used by [env:crowpanel_28] and [env:crowpanel_28_wifi]
# to make room for the dash-hosted Studio SPA embedded in the WiFi build
#   - app0 / app1 grown 1536 KB → 1728 KB (+192 KB each
#   - coredump shrunk 128 KB → 64 KB (-64 KB) to claw back the alignment
#     mismatch so the layout still sums to exactly 4 MB
#   - spiffs partition OFFSET MOVED from 0x310000 → 0x370000. Hardcoded
#     references in canshift-studio + canshift-flasher + the CI boot smoke
#     workflow must follow in separate PRs (out-of-scope here; tracked in
#     the PR body). Field dashes must be USB-reflashed to migrate — OTA from
#     a pre-1077 image to a 1077+ image is unsafe because the running
#     bootloader's partition table still points at the old slots.
# Sizing note: app partition offsets MUST be aligned to 0x10000 (64 KB) on
# ESP32 — so app slot size must itself be a multiple of 64 KB. 1728 KB
# (= 0x1B0000) is the largest aligned size that leaves room for a 512 KB
# SPIFFS. Initial proposals at 1856 KB / 256 KB SPIFFS failed QEMU boot
# smoke at runtime — atomic-write provisioning of the embedded default
# fonts (writeFileAtomic creates .tmp + .bak) blew past the effective
# free-space budget at small partition sizes (SPIFFS overhead is ~30-50 %
